name: WS2812B addressable RGB LED
description: Worldsemi WS2812B RGB LED with its driver inside (a NeoPixel): 24-bit colour received on DIN at 800 kbit/s, the rest passed on at DOUT to chain more LEDs, latched by a 50 us low.

pins.name: DOUT
pins.doc: Data out to the next LED's DIN

t_reset.doc: Low time that latches a frame: 50 us for the WS2812B, 280 us for the WS2812B-V5

functional.claims: 800 kbit/s NRZ on DIN told apart at 0.6 us (between the datasheet's longest 0 and shortest 1); each LED keeps the first 24 bits after a reset (GRB, MSB first) and passes the rest on at DOUT reshaped to 0.4 / 0.8 us highs; a low of t_reset latches the colours; off at power-up; dark and deaf below 3.5 V.
omissions: the light itself (colours reported as the 8-bit PWM levels, no intensity per channel)
supply current (up to 60 mA per LED at full white) and the voltage drop along a strip
the input threshold's dependence on VDD beyond the pin model's levels
